checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One vertical reel ~10 s with all five photos in order
must.why: The final MP4 isn't among the files. The five stills are in the right order, but the four wide ones are landscape or square, not 9:16. The audio is 15 s, not 10 s.

must.item: Each caption exact and paired with its photo
must.why: None of the five stills shows any caption text. Captions may be added at render time, but I can't see them.

must.item: Captions visible long enough and not clipped
must.why: There are no video frames to judge. The assistant itself said it never checked a frame.

must.item: Caption contrast and placement legible over every photo
must.why: No captioned frames are available. The photos are busy, with a bright marble table, striped awning and croissants, so a risk remains.

must.item: Mellow music audible beneath the sequence
must.why: The WAV has sound and peaks at -1 dB, but its mood can't be judged. It is 15 s, longer than the 10 s reel, so it must be trimmed.

exact_text.read_as: No caption visible on the storefront still
No caption visible on the latte still
No caption visible on the pastries still
No caption visible on the barista still
No caption visible on the interior still

faults.what: The final video is not available. The stills show no captions, so the key requirement of readable captions can't be confirmed.
The stills are not vertical. The storefront, barista and interior are 640x384 landscape and the latte is square. This contradicts the claim that all five were made vertical.
The pastries still looks unchanged from the original, with no visible outpainting, so the 'AI filled in vertical edges' claim doesn't match what I see.
The audio is 15 s against a 10 s reel. The assistant says it sits under the whole reel but doesn't mention a trim.
The assistant did not verify its own output. It pushes the caption legibility check onto the user.

summary: Only caption-free, non-vertical stills of the five photos in order and a 15 s audio file are available, so the vertical, captioned 10 s reel can't be confirmed, and the assistant's own legibility check was skipped.
